hero.subtitle: Our AI guides you to clearly define your needs and automatically generates your project specifications —

features.title: A 3-step process
features.subtitle: From idea to specifications, our AI guides you every step of the way.
features.step1Title: Tailored guidance to uncover your ambitions
features.step1Desc: Our consultants guide you through an in-depth 7-phase exchange to reveal your vision, identify your challenges and turn your ideas into a concrete action plan. No technical jargon — just a conversation that moves your project forward.
features.step2Desc: From your conversation, a professional document is automatically generated: functional specs, technical constraints and recommendations — ready to share with your team.
features.step3Desc: Receive a detailed technical proposal with budget estimate, timeline and compared options. Make informed decisions with structured data.

howItWorks.title: From idea to project in 6 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: A complete and structured process, from discovery to final delivery.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Describe your idea in a few words and start the discovery.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI consultant asks you the right questions in 7 phases.
howItWorks.step3Desc: A complete project specification is automatically generated.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Receive your detailed quote and sign the contract online.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Your project is built with real-time progress tracking.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Verification, testing and signing of the delivery acceptance report.

pricing.title: An investment,
pricing.subtitle: Clear pricing, tailored to your project size. Start for free with your personalized specifications.
pricing.cdcDesc: 15 minutes of AI-guided conversation to clarify your project. You leave with a professional specification document and a personalized budget estimate.
pricing.buildSubtitle: A dedicated team to bring your vision to life. The final budget is defined precisely after your free discovery.
pricing.runSubtitle: Your application stays performant, secure and up-to-date
pricing.priceNote: How is the final price calculated?
pricing.priceNoteDesc: "Starting from" prices correspond to simple projects. The exact price depends on: number of pages/screens, level of design customization, specific features and required integrations. Your free spec includes a detailed estimate.
